description: Applies a visual or audio effect to a clip, identifies the exact newly created component (reporting its matchName), and verifies parameter readbacks. Effects resolve by display name only, so a stock name can silently resolve to a third-party plugin; pass expectedMatchName to enforce the effect's identity and fail (rolling back when safe) on a mismatch.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to apply the effect to

effectName.description: The name of the effect to apply (e.g., "Gaussian Blur", "Lumetri Color")

expectedMatchName.description: Optional identity guard: the effect's internal matchName (e.g. "AE.ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"). If the landed effect's matchName differs, the add fails and is rolled back when it is the only user effect on the clip.

parameters.description: Key-value pairs for the effect's parameters

name: apply_effect
